decision: Do not promote unrestricted whole-depth maxima on this coarse-model panel. This does not reject every surface-constrained depth projection.
limitations: Model-assisted annotations; unknown inherited training exposure
Most cores may be unknown or pure-class; small32-square core is0.3072mm across
All depth maxima compete in one final score and calibration includes their empirical multiplicity; correlated pixels do not yield independent-null p-values
The 3D head is teacher-supervised and may detect fibres or neighboring sheets
The cached core retains no full depth-attention weights: comparison localizes suppression to projection, not a specific attention mechanism
Only the9.6um checkpoint is tested; no conclusion about fine checkpoint or physical depth accuracy
No field-scale letter or row evidence

original_execution.status: Executed locally on previously observed development outputs after saving the original retrospective protocol; the original protocol and runner were not public-preregistered. Their original files are not reproduced verbatim here because they contain environment-specific paths.

study_type: Retrospective development-output mechanism screen; published after outcomes
